news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: Revenues and EPS in line with analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹1.80 (up from ₹1.40 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹129.1b (up 20% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹8.39b (up 33% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 6.5% (up from 5.9% in FY 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue was in line with analyst estimates. Earnings per share (EPS) were also in line with analyst expectations. Revenue is forecast to grow 16% p.a. on average during the next 2 years, compared to a 7.9% growth forecast for the Multiline Retail industry in Asia.

news.title: Vishal Mega Mart Limited Appoints Vineet Saksena as Senior Vice President-FMCG and Senior Management Personnel, Effective 3 March 2026
news.body: Vishal Mega Mart Limited has, as per its regulatory filing, appointed Vineet Saksena as Senior Vice President-FMCG and Senior Management Personnel, effective 3 March 2026. With over two decades of expertise across retail, FMCG, and consumer goods, Saksena was most recently Chief Growth Officer at Metro Wholesale.He has previously held senior roles at Metro Wholesale, Reliance Retail, 7-Eleven, Walmart India, Hindustan Unilever, and Singer India.

news.title: Vishal Mega Mart Promoter Entity Reportedly Likely to Sell 6.5% Stake Via Block Deal
news.body: Vishal Mega Mart Limited (NSEI:VMM)'s promoter entity Samayat Services LLP is expected to sell 6.5% stake in the company via a block deal. The shares are likely to be sold at a price of INR 115 apiece, which implies a 10% discount from 27 February 2026 closing price, according to ET Now report. Samayat Services held 54.09% (252.74 crore) in Vishal Mega Mart as of December 31, 2025 and under the stake sale, 30.5 million shares will be offloaded, the report said. Shares of Vishal Mega Mart on 27 February 2026 ended at INR 127.53 on the NSE, up by INR 4.56 or 3.71% from the February 25, 2026 closing price. news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings: EPS exceeds analyst expectations while revenues lag behind
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.67 (up from ₹0.58 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹37.0b (up 18% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹3.13b (up 19% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 8.5% (up from 8.4% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue missed analyst estimates by 1.6%. Earnings per share (EPS) exceeded analyst estimates by 5.6%. Revenue is forecast to grow 17% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 8.7% growth forecast for the Multiline Retail industry in Asia.
